title: 늘었어요? 줄었어요? 변화와 차이 말하기
objective: By the end, you can use words like 증가하다, 감소하다, 차이, and -에 비해 to say in short sentences how something has changed or how two things compare.
summary: Learn ten intermediate words for talking about how things increase, decrease, and differ in everyday life.

task.title: Use change and comparison words
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose, fill in, or rewrite it with a word from this worksheet.

words.meaning: to increase (in number or amount; common in news and formal talk)
words.example: 요즘 자전거로 출근하는 사람이 증가하고 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: More and more people are commuting by bicycle these days.

words.meaning: to decrease (in number or amount; formal)
words.example: 학생 수가 감소해서 반이 하나 없어졌어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The number of students went down, so one class was closed.

words.meaning: to become less or shorter (everyday word for 'go down')
words.exampleMeaning: I work late less often now, so I have free time in the evenings.

words.example: 형하고 저는 나이 차이가 다섯 살이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: My older brother and I are five years apart in age.

words.example: 한국에 온 뒤로 식습관에 큰 변화가 생겼어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My eating habits changed a lot after I came to Korea.

words.example: 이 집은 크기에 비해 월세가 싸요.
words.exampleMeaning: The monthly rent on this place is cheap for its size.

words.meaning: steadily, without stopping, little by little
words.exampleMeaning: My pronunciation got better because I practiced steadily every day.

words.meaning: sharply, suddenly and by a lot
words.example: 오후부터 기온이 급격히 떨어지니까 따뜻하게 입으세요.
words.exampleMeaning: The temperature will drop sharply from the afternoon, so dress warmly.
My friend and I split the pizza half and half.

words.example: 주말에는 손님이 평일보다 두 배 많아요.
words.exampleMeaning: On weekends there are twice as many customers as on weekdays.

exercises: Choose 차이 or 변화 for each blank: ① 두 휴대폰은 가격 ____가 별로 없어요. ② 이사한 후에 생활에 많은 ____가 있었어요.
Fill in the blank with 증가 or 감소: ① 날씨가 추워지면서 아이스크림 판매가 ____했어요. ② 관광객이 ____해서 명동 거리가 아주 복잡해요.
Choose 꾸준히 or 급격히 for each blank: ① 갑자기 손님이 ____ 늘어서 직원을 더 뽑았어요. ② 3년 동안 ____ 저축해서 차를 샀어요.
Fill in the blank with 절반 or 배: ① 이 가방은 세일을 해서 원래 가격의 ____이에요. ② 새 사무실은 전에 쓰던 사무실보다 세 ____ 넓어요.
Rewrite the sentence with -에 비해 instead of 보다: 작년보다 올해 비가 많이 왔어요.
Complete the sentence with 줄어들다 in the past tense: 온라인으로 예약을 하니까 병원에서 기다리는 시간이 ____.
answers: 작년에 비해 올해 비가 많이 왔어요. (올해는 작년에 비해 비가 많이 왔어요.)
